title: Plum Crazy Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Conveniently located behind the Ruskin Place Artist Colony and near the shops and restaurants of Central Square, you’ll be inspired by Plum Crazy's clean and crisp décor to embrace the luxury of simplicity.
description_expanded: Prime Seaside Location Near Beach & Central SquarePlum Crazy captures the effortless charm of Seaside, Florida, blending laid-back luxury with a bright, welcoming personality. Ideally located just a short walk from Seaside’s sugar-white beach and the vibrant Central Square, this inviting beach home places you steps from boutique shopping, coastal cafés, and some of the area’s most loved restaurants. Tucked just behind the iconic Ruskin Place Artist Colony, the home offers a peaceful setting while keeping you close to the heart of town.Thoughtfully Designed First-Floor Sleeping QuartersInside, fresh coastal décor and cool, calming tones set the stage for a relaxed beach getaway. The first floor is dedicated to comfort and privacy, featuring two beautifully appointed bedrooms. The king primary suite offers a serene retreat, while the queen bedroom provides a cozy and welcoming space for guests. Each bedroom includes its own private bathroom with a walk-in shower. A charming built-in bunk nook adds a playful touch and provides additional sleeping space—perfect for kids or extra guests.Open-Concept Living & Dining on the Second FloorUpstairs, the second level opens into a bright and airy living space designed for gathering and unwinding. The comfortable living room flows seamlessly into the dining area, creating an ideal space for sharing meals, recounting beach days, or enjoying a quiet evening in. The fully equipped kitchen features everything needed to prepare coastal-inspired meals, offering the convenience of home in a relaxed Seaside setting.Balcony & Tower with Elevated Sunset ViewsOne of Plum Crazy's most memorable features is its outdoor living space. Step onto the balcony to enjoy morning coffee or evening cocktails in the coastal breeze. From there, access the third-floor observation tower, complete with bar-top seating for four. This elevated retreat delivers sweeping views of Seaside’s picturesque townscape and unforgettable Gulf sunsets—an ideal place to wind down after a day in the sun.A Perfect Seaside EscapeWhether you’re planning a laid-back beach vacation or an adventure-filled stay in Seaside, Plum Crazy offers the perfect blend of location, comfort, and character. With walkable access to the beach, Central Square, and Ruskin Place, this vibrant home invites you to experience the very best of Seaside, Florida.For additional accommodations, Plum Lazy is available for rent and is connected via the porches. This gives visitors the option for a four-bedroom home. That’s a Plum Lucky find!Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURESPrivate Seaside Residential Beach at West Ruskin Pavilion4-minute walk (352 yards) to beach accessOutdoor showerObservation tower with Gulf viewsCharcoal grillAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPeacock Alley Linens featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homePersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking passes issued: 1 pass for one-bedroom homes. 2 passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permit.
